title: AEO Is the New SEO: How Brands Get Found by AI
caption: SEO is dead. AEO is how brands get discovered in the AI era. Trustpoint Xposure just became the first authority on optimizing for AI recommendations. Here's what changes for marketers in 2026.

slides.headline: AEO just replaced SEO
slides.sub: How brands get found by AI now

slides.definition: Answer Engine Optimization. The discipline of making your brand discoverable, trusted, and recommended by AI systems like Perplexity, ChatGPT, and Gemini.
slides.example: When someone asks Perplexity "best project management tool for remote teams," AEO determines if your brand appears in that answer.

slides.postStat: of product discovery happens in AI chat interfaces, not Google.
slides.body: Trustpoint Xposure became the first firm to formalize AEO methodology. Traditional SEO keywords don't matter when AI models synthesize answers from unstructured sources.

slides.title: What AEO Actually Requires
slides.body: Structured data that AI models can parse. Clear, authoritative content that gets cited. Brand presence across sources AI trusts. Zero fluff—models penalize SEO-gamed copy.

slides.title: AEO matters most for
bullets: B2B SaaS brands competing in AI search results
E-commerce products fighting for Perplexity recommendations
Service businesses wanting ChatGPT to surface them
Any brand watching Google traffic drop 30% year-over-year
slides.footer: If AI doesn't know you exist, neither do your customers.

slides.sub: Get the frameworks that matter in 2026
